title: Rubisco temperature-calibration evidence audit: measured crop series do not supply verified microbial bridges
question: Can public matched same-enzyme temperature measurements independently constrain the Q10 used in the 2025 coupled-assay calibration?
method: Protocol frozen before scoring; reconcile all cells of the unfiltered 634-row historical workbook to the original XLSX; enumerate every literal-species cross-temperature candidate without filtering exclusions; parse original primary crop Table I and Table S1; calculate observed ratios only; re-extract eleven calibration overlaps from original deposited library; audit identity/origin/units/conditions; test strict and transfer-assumption rank models with explicit null direction.
result: No eligible within-origin in-vitro temperature pair in the full supplied workbook. Original public crop tables yield 20 source-defined native population series (60 points; 60 dependent contrasts), but zero overlap species matches or exact measured 25→30°C pairs. No verified exact-enzyme bridge raises calibration rank. Plant data raise two-parameter rank to 2 only under an unverified universal-Q10 assumption; allowing distinct plant Q10 retains microbial assay/temperature confounding. This is bounded audited coverage, not worldwide absence or evidence that Q10=2.2 is wrong.

limitations: No new work here has human expert review.
Exhaustive enumeration covers the supplied workbook and successfully retrieved 20-crop table, not every latent table in all 67 citations or worldwide literature.
Original Orr 75-species supplement unavailable at tested endpoints; microbial Gubernator/Jordan full numerical tables unresolved. Source-access failure is not biological absence.
Crop identity means same source-defined native population/cultivar, not homogeneous molecular isoform. Two cultivars unspecified. No inferred equivalence to calibration constructs.
No measured 30°C point in extracted crop table; no temperature imputation/interpolation. Interval Q10 is not a universal coefficient.
Covariance and exact endpoint n unavailable; reported rounded SEs retained; no inferred confidence intervals or independent-pair significance tests.
Third-party raw inputs retained locally only; redistribution license not identified for most inputs. Public acquisition instructions and hashes provided.
The previous eleven-overlap rank-1 result is prior work, not counted as C06 contribution.

scientific_assessment.limit: The original authors already disclosed calibration and temperature assumptions.
